ai_llm_rag_capabilities.core_approach: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): every answer is generated from passages retrieved from the client's controlled corpus and cites those passages, rather than relying on a model's parametric memory
ai_llm_rag_capabilities.grounding: Answers grounded in validated material (accounting standards, tax doctrine, the commercial code, collective agreements, internal procedures), limiting unsupported generation
capabilities: Structured extraction with source linking (e.g. extracting a figure from a document and linking it to its source passage)
Template-guided drafting (client letters, mission notes, file syntheses)

factual_reliability_of_figures.principle: Reliability of numeric outputs is treated as a first-class requirement
factual_reliability_of_figures.grounding: Figure-bearing statements are grounded in and linked to a source document
factual_reliability_of_figures.ungrounded_figure_handling: The platform can be configured to refrain from producing an ungrounded numeric claim and to flag a missing source rather than guess
factual_reliability_of_figures.requirement_addressed: The firm's requirement that no ungrounded figure be produced

model_options.characteristics: Fully auditable; well suited to reliability-driven and sovereignty-driven requirements; somewhat lower raw performance on the most complex tasks
Higher performance; some non-European; lower internal transparency

model_selection_principle: The choice trades performance against explainability and sovereignty, and is made per engagement

steps: Corpus curation with the firm's experts
Prompt and template design per use case
methodologies.quality_measurement: Answer quality measured with a labelled evaluation set built with the client (groundedness, relevance, factual support, correctness of cited figures); metrics reported during the pilot

features: Every interaction logged for a posteriori audit
explainability.human_oversight: Built into the workflow — the assistant proposes, the professional validates and signs

personalisation_and_data_use.adaptation_method: Primarily through corpus curation and retrieval/prompt configuration, which does not require training on personal or client data
personalisation_and_data_use.data_use_terms: Defined with the firm and the compliance function before any such use

use_cases_delivered.use_case: Regulatory-information assistant for a national professional order
use_cases_delivered.note: Closest analogue for an accounting/audit firm

use_cases_delivered.use_case: Claims-handling assistant for a mutual health insurer
Social-services case-work assistant for a regional council
